faqs.question: How do I convert SVG to PNG online?
faqs.answer: Select or drag your SVG file into our converter, choose your desired output width/height or resolution scale (1x, 2x, 4x), and click Download PNG.

faqs.question: Does converting SVG to PNG support transparent backgrounds?
faqs.answer: Yes! If your SVG has a transparent background, the resulting PNG preserves full alpha transparency.

faqs.question: Can I upscale SVG to high resolution without losing quality?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because SVG is a resolution-independent vector format, you can upscale to 4K, 8K, or custom pixel dimensions with razor-sharp edges.

faqs.question: Are my SVG files uploaded to any server?
faqs.answer: No. The rasterization runs entirely inside your browser using HTML5 Canvas. Your vectors remain 100% private.

faqs.question: Is this SVG to PNG converter completely free?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is 100% free forever with no watermarks or file size restrictions.

faqs.question: Will rasterizing SVG vector graphics make them blurry?
faqs.answer: No. Because SVGs are defined mathematically by XML coordinates, you can scale them to 2x, 4x, or higher resolutions before rasterizing, ensuring ultra-crisp output.

faqs.question: Is alpha transparency preserved?
faqs.answer: Yes. Unless your SVG explicitly defines a background rect or fill, transparent areas remain fully transparent in the exported PNG.

faqs.question: Are complex SVG gradients and CSS filters supported?
faqs.answer: Yes. The browser's native SVG rendering engine processes standard linear/radial gradients, clip paths, and vector transforms.

faqs.question: Does the conversion require an internet connection?
faqs.answer: No. The conversion executes entirely within your browser memory using the native HTML5 Canvas API.

faqs.question: Kann man das Bild ohne Qualitätsverlust vergrößern?
faqs.answer: Ja. Da SVG ein Vektorformat ist, können Sie beliebig hohe Auflösungen (z. B. 4K) gestochen scharf erzeugen.

faqs.question: Werden Dateien auf einen Server übertragen?
faqs.answer: Nein. Alles wird lokal in Ihrem Browser mit HTML5 Canvas berechnet.

faqs.question: Ist das Werkzeug kostenlos?
faqs.answer: Ja, dauerhaft kostenlos und ohne Wasserzeichen.

faqs.question: Wird die Grafik durch das Rastern unscharf?
faqs.answer: Nein. Da SVGs mathematisch definiert sind, liefert die 2x- oder 4x-Skalierung gestochen scharfe Ergebnisse.

faqs.question: Bleibt die Transparenz erhalten?
faqs.answer: Ja. Transparente Bereiche im SVG bleiben im exportierten PNG vollständig transparent.

faqs.question: Funktionieren Farbverläufe und Vektormasken?
faqs.answer: Ja. Der Browser rendert lineare und radiale Verläufe sowie Schnittmasken präzise.

faqs.question: Funktioniert die Umwandlung ohne Internetverbindung?
faqs.answer: Ja. Die Verarbeitung erfolgt vollständig lokal im Browser-Speicher.

faqs.question: SVG를 PNG로 변환하는 방법은?

faqs.question: 투명 배경이 유지되나요?

faqs.question: 고해상도로 확대해도 선명한가요?

faqs.question: 파일이 서버로 전송되나요?

faqs.question: 무료로 이용할 수 있나요?

faqs.question: 벡터를 PNG로 래스터화하면 외곽선이 흐려지나요?
faqs.answer: 아닙니다. SVG는 수학적 좌표 기반이므로 2배, 4배 등 높은 해상도 배율을 지정하여 렌더링하면 초고화질의 선명한 결과를 얻을 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 투명 배경이 그대로 유지되나요?
faqs.answer: 네. SVG 자체에 배경색이 칠해져 있지 않은 한, 투명 영역이 온전히 보존된 PNG로 저장됩니다.

faqs.question: 그라데이션이나 클리핑 패스 등 복잡한 효과도 렌더링되나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 브라우저 네이티브 SVG 렌더링 엔진이 선형/방사형 그라데이션 및 벡터 마스크를 정확히 재현합니다.

faqs.question: 인터넷 연결 없이도 작동하나요?
